text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the long trip. You must be 
tired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after things settled down in the 
Twinkle Series. We went on the hot springs 
trip won from the lottery before. This 
trip was planned for rest and 
rejuvenation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or so it was supposed to be... 
Unfortunately, some work came up right 
before, turning our vacation plan into a 
whirlwind round-trip.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I told you earlier not to worry 
about it any further.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful time chatting along the 
way. The boxed lunch was truly lovely as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, a wonderful hot spring 
awaits us. A succession of joys—truly a 
magnificent journey.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"So, um—the hot spring inn is over that... 
My, what a magnificent gate...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It seems these are famous hot springs. 
Fufu! Shall we head over right away?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While it may not have the fervor of a 
racetrack, we can surely become one in the 
warm waters.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Chatting with total strangers sitting 
next to me in the open-air bath, or 
watching TV together in the sauna..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about everyone gathered in a 
circle in one place, healing together, 
warms my heart.
choice_data_list:
Then let's take a good, long soak and 
enjoy it today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Haa, that was a wonderful bath...♪ Um, 
where is Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, did I keep you waiting? I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I stammered, unsure of how to reply.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, as luck would have it, an urgent 
task popped up out of nowhere, and by the 
time I finished dealing with it, it had 
gotten this late.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could it be that you haven't gone 
into the hot springs yet?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Your expression looks rather stiff. It 
hardly looks as though you just soaked in 
a hot bath.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting, so please do come in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate her thoughtfulness... 
the departure time for the return 
Shinkansen is drawing near.
choice_data_list:
There's no time, I'll have to give up this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh!? But—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Still. ...Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...That is unfortunate. However, we cannot 
afford to miss our ride.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Understood...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you care for some tea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accept the tea from her. The warm 
temperature feels comforting against my 
palms.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And also... may I have another moment? 
There is something I wish to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I... respect you deeply.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Their competence as a Trainer goes 
without saying, but their fiery passion 
for racing exceeds anyone else's."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, your sense of duty to support 
Umamusume was clearly felt just by 
standing beside you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why the circle that started 
with just the two of them could eventually 
expand even to the whole world—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm happy. But—
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"You couldn't go into the hot springs, 
could you?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"When you're already exhausted from work, 
that is simply too much. ...Besides."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Even though we came on a hot spring 
trip together, I felt kind of lonely being 
the only one warming up.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"So at the very least... if I could just 
warm your hands. Even if it's just a warm 
feeling, I thought..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., but it is not a lie. These are all 
my true, heartfelt feelings—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Um... I did something 
strange, didn't I?"
choice_data_list: No, it made me really happy. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though taken aback at first... my heart 
was already warmed by such pure-hearted 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No. The unexpected is simply bound to 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However... you're right. In that case, may 
I make a selfish request of you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Would you like to come again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well, they had footbaths and everything. I 
just really wanted to warm up together 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long it takes, I hope the 
two of us can do this again someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Victoire Pisa...
